items.title: SEO, AEO & GEO
items.description: Modern search extends beyond Google. We help your brand rank on traditional search engines (SEO), get cited by AI answer engines like ChatGPT and Perplexity (AEO), and appear in generative AI responses (GEO) — so you're visible wherever your audience searches.
items.directAnswer: SEO (Search Engine Optimization) is the process of improving your website's ranking on Google and other search engines to attract qualified organic visitors without paying for ads. AEO (Answer Engine Optimization) optimizes your content so AI tools like ChatGPT and Perplexity cite your brand when users ask questions. GEO (Generative Engine Optimization) structures your online presence so generative AI platforms naturally recommend your business in their responses — giving you visibility across every form of modern search.

faqs.question: What is the difference between SEO, AEO, and GEO?
faqs.answer: SEO (Search Engine Optimization) helps your website rank higher on Google and Bing. AEO (Answer Engine Optimization) optimizes your content to be cited by AI-powered answer engines like ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Google's AI Overviews. GEO (Generative Engine Optimization) structures your content so generative AI platforms reference your brand in their responses. Together, they give your brand maximum search visibility in 2025 and beyond.

faqs.question: How long does SEO take to show results?
faqs.answer: SEO typically shows measurable improvements within 3–6 months, with significant results in 6–12 months for competitive industries. Technical fixes and local SEO often show faster results. AEO and GEO improvements can appear sooner as AI platforms constantly re-crawl and update their knowledge. We provide monthly reports so you always know where you stand.

faqs.question: Can SEO help generate leads for my business?
faqs.answer: Absolutely. We focus on commercial and transactional keywords that attract visitors with buying intent — not just traffic. Our on-page optimisation, landing page strategy, and conversion-focused content are designed to turn organic visitors into qualified leads and customers.

faqs.question: What industries does Branding Hours specialize in for SEO?
faqs.answer: We've delivered SEO results across a wide range of industries including e-commerce, real estate, healthcare, SaaS, education, hospitality, and professional services. Our team adapts strategy to your niche, competition level, and growth goals.

faqs.question: Do you provide monthly SEO reports?
faqs.answer: Yes. Every client receives detailed monthly SEO reports covering keyword rankings, organic traffic trends, backlink growth, technical health, and conversion data. We also include actionable insights and the next month's priorities so you always know what we're working on and why.

It combines organic content — posts, Reels, Stories, and carousels — with paid social advertising to reach both existing followers and cold audiences. A well-executed social media strategy turns passive scrollers into loyal customers and brand advocates.

faqs.question: How often will you post on my social media accounts?
faqs.answer: Posting frequency is based on your plan and platform best practices. Typically, we post 4–7 times per week on Instagram, 3–5 times on LinkedIn, and daily Stories/Reels where relevant. We build a monthly content calendar and share it for approval before publishing.

faqs.question: Can you create Reels and short-form video content?
faqs.answer: Yes. Short-form video is central to our social media strategy. We conceptualise, script, produce, edit, and publish Reels, YouTube Shorts, and other short-form videos — optimised for each platform's algorithm and your brand's visual language.

faqs.question: How do you measure the success of social media campaigns?
faqs.answer: We track reach, impressions, engagement rate, follower growth, website clicks, lead form submissions, and ad performance metrics like CTR and CPL. Monthly reports include benchmark comparisons and forward-looking recommendations.

faqs.question: Do you handle social media advertising in addition to organic content?
faqs.answer: Yes. Our social media service covers both organic content and paid social advertising. We run Meta Ads (Instagram + Facebook), LinkedIn Ads, and other platform campaigns — often combining both for maximum brand growth and lead generation.

items.title: Paid Media Marketing
items.description: Reach the right audience at the right moment with performance-driven paid campaigns across Google, Meta, YouTube, and beyond — built to maximize ROI, generate quality leads, and scale your business.
items.directAnswer: Paid Media Marketing is the practice of paying to place targeted ads in front of potential customers across Google, Meta (Facebook and Instagram), YouTube, and other platforms. Unlike organic marketing which takes months to build, paid media delivers immediate visibility and measurable leads — making it one of the fastest ways to generate revenue. It includes search ads, display advertising, social media ads, video campaigns, Performance Max, and remarketing.

faqs.question: What budget should I start with for paid media campaigns?
faqs.answer: We recommend a minimum monthly ad spend of ₹30,000–₹50,000 to gather meaningful data and optimise effectively. However, we work with budgets of all sizes and always recommend the right starting point based on your industry, goals, and competition level. Our management fee is separate from the ad spend.

faqs.question: How quickly can paid media campaigns go live?
faqs.answer: After onboarding and strategy sign-off, campaigns are typically live within 7–10 business days. This includes account setup, ad creative production, audience configuration, conversion tracking, and quality checks. For urgent campaigns, we can fast-track in as little as 5 days.

faqs.question: What is a Performance Max campaign?
faqs.answer: Performance Max (PMax) is Google's AI-powered campaign type that runs across all Google channels — Search, Display, YouTube, Gmail, Maps, and Discover — from a single campaign. It uses machine learning to find the highest-converting placements automatically. We use PMax strategically alongside standard Search and Display campaigns for maximum reach and efficiency.

faqs.question: How do you measure ROAS (Return on Ad Spend)?
faqs.answer: ROAS = Revenue generated ÷ Ad spend. For example, a ROAS of 4x means every ₹1 spent on ads returns ₹4 in revenue. We set up conversion tracking via Google Tag Manager, Meta Pixel, and CRM integrations to accurately attribute revenue to campaigns — giving you clear visibility of what's working.

faqs.question: Do you manage Meta Ads and Google Ads together?
faqs.answer: Yes. Many of our clients run both Google and Meta campaigns simultaneously, which we manage as a unified paid media strategy. Google captures high-intent search traffic while Meta builds awareness and retargets warm audiences — together they create a full-funnel paid media engine.

items.title: Branding, Design & Brand Strategy
items.description: Build a brand that speaks before you do — from foundational strategy to visual identity, we craft brands that command attention, build lasting trust, and grow with your business.
items.directAnswer: Branding is the strategic process of defining and expressing what your business stands for — through your visual identity, messaging, values, and personality — in a way that resonates with your audience and differentiates you from competitors. Brand strategy determines how you position your brand and who you speak to, while visual identity design (logo, colours, typography) gives it a recognizable face. Together, they transform a business into a brand that people trust, remember, and choose.

faqs.question: What is included in a brand strategy?
faqs.answer: Brand strategy covers your brand's positioning (what you stand for and who you serve), messaging and tone of voice, value proposition, competitive differentiation, and audience personas. A strong brand strategy is the blueprint that ensures every piece of design, copy, and communication works together to build a consistent and trusted brand.

faqs.question: How long does the branding process take?
faqs.answer: A full brand identity project (strategy + visual identity + brand guidelines) typically takes 4–8 weeks. Logo-only projects can be delivered in 2–3 weeks. Timeline depends on the scope, number of revision rounds, and how quickly feedback is provided. We work to clear milestones so you always know where we are.

faqs.question: Do you work with both startups and established businesses?
faqs.answer: Yes. We work with early-stage startups building their brand from scratch, growth-stage companies refining their identity, and established businesses undergoing a rebrand. Our process adapts to where you are — whether you need a complete brand build or a strategic evolution of what already exists.

faqs.question: What file formats will I receive for my logo and brand assets?
faqs.answer: You'll receive your logo and brand assets in all standard formats — SVG, PNG, PDF, EPS, and AI. We provide files optimised for web, print, social media, and large-format use. You own all source files and final deliverables outright.

faqs.question: Do you offer packaging design?
faqs.answer: Yes. Packaging design is part of our branding service. We design product packaging that reflects your brand identity, stands out on shelf and in unboxing experiences, and meets production print specifications. We work closely with your manufacturer or printer to ensure what we design can be produced exactly as intended.

faqs.question: How long does a product shoot take?
faqs.answer: A typical product photography session takes half a day to a full day depending on the number of products and shot types required. Brand campaigns and lifestyle shoots are scoped individually. We provide a detailed shoot plan before the day so there are no surprises on set.

faqs.question: Can you do photography for e-commerce platforms like Amazon or Shopify?

faqs.question: Do you shoot on-location or in a studio?
faqs.answer: Both. We have access to a professional studio setup for product and brand photography, and we also shoot on-location for lifestyle, event, and campaign content. The right setting is chosen based on your brief and the visual story we're telling.

items.title: Hotstar Marketing & OTT Advertising
items.description: Reach millions of engaged viewers on Disney+ Hotstar with targeted OTT advertising campaigns — precise audience targeting, compelling video creatives, and full performance reporting for brand awareness and measurable results.
items.directAnswer: Hotstar Marketing refers to advertising on Disney+ Hotstar — India's largest streaming platform with 500+ million users — by placing video ads before or during premium content like IPL cricket, web series, and Hollywood movies. OTT (Over-The-Top) advertising reaches engaged, captive viewers in a full-screen environment, offering precise audience targeting by demographics, location, and content preference that traditional TV advertising cannot match. It is one of the most powerful brand-building channels available in India today.

faqs.question: What is Hotstar (Disney+ Hotstar) advertising?
faqs.answer: Disney+ Hotstar is one of India's largest streaming platforms with over 500 million users. Hotstar advertising allows brands to place video ads before, during, or after premium content — including live sports like IPL, T20 World Cup, Hollywood movies, and popular web series. It offers a highly engaged, captive audience in a premium viewing environment.

faqs.question: What ad formats are available on Hotstar?
faqs.answer: Hotstar supports several ad formats including pre-roll ads (before content starts), mid-roll ads (during content), display banners, L-band overlays (during live streaming), and branded content integrations. We recommend the best format mix based on your campaign objectives — whether brand awareness, recall, or direct response.

faqs.question: Can Hotstar campaigns target specific regions or languages?
faqs.answer: Yes. Hotstar offers granular geographic targeting at the state, city, and regional level — ideal for regional brands or national brands running localised campaigns. You can also target by content language (Hindi, Tamil, Telugu, Kannada, etc.) to reach specific linguistic audiences.

faqs.question: Is OTT advertising more effective than traditional TV advertising?
faqs.answer: OTT advertising on Hotstar offers several advantages over traditional TV: precise audience targeting (vs. broad broadcast), no time-slot dependency, measurable performance metrics (impressions, view-through rate, reach), ad-skipping control, and full-screen engagement on connected devices. For reaching digital-first and premium audiences, OTT often delivers better ROI than traditional TV.

faqs.question: How is Hotstar campaign performance tracked and reported?
faqs.answer: We receive detailed campaign performance data including total impressions, unique reach, view-through rate, frequency, completion rate, and geographic distribution. For brand awareness objectives, we can also run brand lift studies. All data is compiled into monthly performance reports with clear insights and recommendations for the next campaign cycle.

items.title: Influencer Marketing
items.description: Scale brand awareness, trust, and conversions through creator-led campaigns that connect your brand with highly engaged, niche audiences — from micro-influencers to macro creators across Instagram and YouTube.
items.directAnswer: Influencer Marketing is a strategy where brands collaborate with social media creators — people with engaged, loyal followings — to authentically promote products or services to their audience. It works because consumers trust creator recommendations 4x more than traditional advertising. Campaigns can leverage micro-influencers (10K–100K followers) for niche, high-engagement reach, or macro-influencers (100K–1M+) for broad brand awareness — with performance fully tracked through reach, engagement, and conversion metrics.

faqs.question: How do you find and select the right influencers for my brand?
faqs.answer: We use a combination of influencer discovery tools and manual vetting to identify creators who genuinely align with your brand — not just those with the highest follower count. We analyse engagement rate, audience demographics, content quality, authenticity, and previous brand collaborations before recommending any influencer. Every partnership is strategic, not random.

faqs.question: Do you work with micro-influencers?
faqs.answer: Yes, and we strongly recommend micro-influencers (10K–100K followers) for most campaigns. Micro-influencers typically have 3–5x higher engagement rates than mega-influencers, more authentic audience relationships, and niche-specific credibility. They're often more cost-effective and deliver better conversions for direct-response campaigns. We build the right mix of micro and macro influencers based on your goals.

faqs.question: How is influencer campaign performance measured?
faqs.answer: We track a range of metrics depending on campaign objectives: reach and impressions (awareness), engagement rate and comments (interest), website clicks and promo code usage (conversions), follower growth, and earned media value. For e-commerce clients, we set up trackable affiliate links and unique discount codes to attribute revenue directly to influencer campaigns.

faqs.question: What industries benefit most from influencer marketing?
faqs.answer: Influencer marketing works exceptionally well for fashion and lifestyle, beauty and personal care, food and beverage, fitness and wellness, travel, technology and gadgets, and e-commerce brands. However, with the right creator match, virtually any B2C brand can benefit. We've run effective influencer campaigns across diverse categories and tailor the strategy to your product and audience.

faqs.question: Can influencer-created content be repurposed for paid ads?
faqs.answer: Yes, and this is one of the most powerful applications of influencer content. User-generated content (UGC) and influencer videos often outperform brand-produced creatives in paid social ads because they feel authentic and trustworthy. We negotiate content usage rights as part of influencer contracts so you can repurpose top-performing content across Meta Ads, YouTube Ads, and other channels.
